description: Step into the colorful world of Maths Pals, where six delightful animal friends are ready to make math fun, interactive, and easy to learn! Designed for kids in Grade 1 and Grade 2, this engaging educational game will help young learners develop essential math skills while having a great time.
name: Maths Pals
intro: Join six adorable animal friends on a journey to master math! From counting to multiplication, tackle fun challenges, earn stars, and watch your skills soar—all at your own pace!
